caseName: New Louisville Jockey Club v. City of Oakdale
caseNameFull: New Louisville Jockey Club, in Error v. The City of Oakdale and Lennox Land Company, in Error v. City of Oakdale
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Kentucky.
attorneys: Mr. Wm. H. Field and Mr. Bernard Flexner for the plaintiffs in error. Mr. J. M. Chilton for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Mount Pleasant v. Beckwith, 100 U. S. 531; Kelly v. Pittsburgh, 104 U. S. 80; Castillo v. McConnico, 168 U. S. 674.
